messages:
Maya (PM): Short thread to lock the Console observability MVP. Need final call on templates, trace sampling defaults, per-tenant cost estimate, and rollout pilot.
Arjun (Eng): Keep it minimal: 2 templates (overview + cost-by-route), tenant_id tag in spans, default sample 0.5%, error-capture behind flag.
Priya (SRE): Ops: 0.5% ok. Must have per-tenant daily cap (1000 traces) and auto-throttle at 70% quota. Escalation needs manual approval.
Ben (Data): Phase 1 cost = estimated from aggregates (tokens, ms, model_unit_price). CSV export possible. Full attribution = next phase.
Zoe (Design): UX: show "Estimated" badge + confidence tooltip. Dashboards: three cards: estimated spend, top routes, confidence.
Nate (CS): Pilot customers (AcmeHealth + FinTrack) signed up for estimated numbers + CSV export. They'll be in the pilot.
Maya (PM): Launch acceptance (agreed): dashboards (2 templates), tracing (tenant tagging + 0.5% default), cost (estimated per-tenant + CSV), errors (top-10), pilot to 3 customers, feature-flagged.
Arjun (Eng): I'll open PR for tenant tag and sampling hooks; will set trace TTL 7d.
Priya (SRE): I'll add alerts and throttle rules. Also require support approval flow for sampling escalation.
Ben (Data): I'll deliver mapping doc and sample dataset EOD.
Zoe (Design): Posting mocks in thread tomorrow AM.
Nate (CS): I'll prepare pilot comms and support runbook.
deploy-bot: build/ci-pipeline #789 started for branch feature/obs-mvp (1797654399)
Maya (PM): Thanks team 1closing. If blockers, drop here or ping #eng-oncall.
